description: Pick (or un-pick) units on a pick list — the pick screen's collect and un-pick. Each line names a pick list line (lineId, or the SKU), a quantity in the line's unit and the location it comes from (optional when one location can serve it); lot-, expiry- and serial-tracked items name their lot, expiry or serials. Picking reserves the units at that location for the order. Or set autoAllocate=true (no lines) to pick every remaining line from the oldest stock first, as the Auto allocate button does; serial-tracked lines are left for a manual pick. A list not started yet is started first (picker defaults to you). The preview shows each line's picked quantity before and after. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt. Then complete_pick_list hands the picked units to packing.

autoAllocate.description: Pick every remaining line from the oldest stock first (earliest expiry, then oldest receipt), instead of naming lines.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lines.description: Lines to pick or un-pick (max 100). All lines commit together or not at all. Omit with autoAllocate=true.

action.description: pick (default) takes units for the line; unpick puts picked units back.

expiry.description: Expiry date (yyyy-MM-dd), for date-tracked items. Optional when the location holds one expiry.

lineId.description: Pick list line id (GUID) from get_pick_list. Either lineId or sku is required.

location.description: Location name, code, barcode or id in the pick list's warehouse. Optional when exactly one location can serve the quantity.

lot.description: Lot number, for lot-tracked items. Optional when the location holds one lot.

quantity.description: Units to pick or put back, in the line's unit of measure (> 0).

serials.description: Serial numbers, for serial-tracked items (one per unit).

sku.description: Item SKU on the pick list; must match exactly one line.

pickListId.description: Pick list id (GUID) or number from list_pick_lists.

picker.description: Picker (team member email or user id) when this call starts the list. Defaults to you.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.
